title: Practice 15: Standing, lying, sitting — and putting

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Which fits? *Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки»*
exercises.ru: Не ___, Мамо! не встанем! умрем, а не встанем! — кричали запорожцы.
exercises.why: «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc.)» (ставить, класть). «Садиться / сесть implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"»; сидеть, лежать, стоять answer "где?". — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки».
